sections.label: The opening
sections.line: We never start by asking a customer to move: we integrate with what they run and build around it.
sections.para: Then their system gets better and we retire code, or ours becomes the better place.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Today's MVP, integrate, build around, open source, two endings, commodity parts.

sections.label: What happened today
sections.line: An MVP fitted an organisation's explorer mode, and they said: we use Odoo. That is the point.
sections.para: Go to where the customer already is.

sections.label: Integrate with whatever is on the other side
sections.line: Odoo 12 or 20, Salesforce, a spreadsheet: we use what the customer has.
sections.para: They need not wait to be upgraded to use the future.

sections.label: Build around it
sections.line: Leave the core alone; add agents, records, policies and better interfaces, starting with manual workflows.
sections.para: Odoo is a strong platform to prototype on.

sections.label: The open source model
sections.line: Leverage what exists, make it better, use the upgrades; I build on Claude rather than replace it.

sections.label: Two ways it ends
sections.line: Most likely their system ships what we built and we retire code; sometimes ours becomes the better place.
sections.para: Replacement is a path, never a start.

sections.label: Only commodity parts underneath
sections.line: No database or servers of our own, only commodity parts, so we carry very little code.
sections.para: Delete code when they improve; little to scale when we win.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: The organisation unnamed until it reviews; tests on Community images; a judgement; a pattern.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Today's demo and conversation, and earlier articles.
